description: This file defines the ShiftAssignment class and related functions for managing employee shift schedules, including validation, event retrieval, shift timing calculations, and handling shift overlaps within an HR management system.

classes.name: ShiftAssignment
classes.description: Represents an employee's shift assignment with validation and overlap checking.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the shift assignment, including active employee check and date overlaps.

methods.name: validate_overlapping_dates
methods.description: Checks for overlapping shift assignments for the same employee.

methods.name: throw_overlap_error
methods.description: Raises an error if overlapping active shift assignments are found.

methods.name: get_events
methods.description: Retrieves shift assignment events within a date range, filtered by user.

methods.name: add_assignments
methods.description: Adds shift assignment records to the events list within a date range.

methods.name: get_shift_type_timing
methods.description: Fetches start and end times for given shift types.

methods.name: get_employee_shift
methods.description: Returns the shift type assigned to an employee on a specific date, considering defaults and holidays.

methods.name: get_employee_shift_timings
methods.description: Provides previous, current, and next shift details for an employee at a given timestamp.

methods.name: get_shift_details
methods.description: Returns detailed shift timing information for a given shift type and date.

methods.name: get_actual_start_end_datetime_of_shift
methods.description: Calculates actual start and end datetimes of the shift in which a timestamp falls.
